WITH matching AS (
    SELECT 'otel_demo' AS dataset, coalesce(e."component", '(no component)') AS k FROM "huge"."otel_log" AS e WHERE e."level" = ANY(%s::VARCHAR[]) AND e."ts" >= %s AND e."ts" < %s
),
grouped AS (SELECT dataset, k, count(*) AS n FROM matching GROUP BY dataset, k),
ranked AS (SELECT dataset, k, n, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY n DESC, dataset, k) AS rnk FROM grouped),
marked AS (
    SELECT dataset, k, n, rnk,
           sum(CASE WHEN rnk > %s THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY dataset) AS hidden
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT dataset, k, n, rnk, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS groups FROM marked WHERE rnk <= %s OR hidden = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT dataset, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), sum(n), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), count(*) FROM grouped GROUP BY dataset
ORDER BY rnk NULLS LAST, dataset

WITH matching AS (
    SELECT 'otel_demo' AS dataset, CASE WHEN coalesce(e."component", '(no component)') = ANY(%s::VARCHAR[]) THEN coalesce(e."component", '(no component)') ELSE '(other)' END AS k, e."component" AS src, e."ts" AS ts, (e."ts" >= %s AND e."ts" < %s) AS in_scope, FALSE AS in_prev FROM "huge"."otel_log" AS e WHERE e."level" = ANY(%s::VARCHAR[]) AND e."ts" >= %s AND e."ts" < %s
),
cur AS (
    SELECT dataset, k, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT src) AS sources, min(ts) AS first_seen,
           max(ts) AS last_seen
    FROM matching WHERE in_scope GROUP BY dataset, k
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT dataset, k, time_bucket(INTERVAL '7 days', ts) AS week, count(*) AS n,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_prev) AS prev
    FROM matching GROUP BY dataset, k, week
),
grid AS (
    SELECT 'otel_demo' AS dataset, week FROM (SELECT unnest(generate_series(time_bucket(INTERVAL '7 days', %s::TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '7 days', time_bucket(INTERVAL '7 days', %s::TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '7 days', INTERVAL '7 days')) AS week) AS whole WHERE week + INTERVAL '7 days' <= %s::TIMESTAMP OR week >= %s::TIMESTAMP
),
wanted AS (
    SELECT 'otel_demo' AS dataset, unnest(%s::VARCHAR[]) AS k
),
med AS (
    SELECT wanted.dataset, wanted.k, median(coalesce(weekly.n, 0)) AS median_week, count(*) AS weeks
    FROM wanted JOIN grid ON grid.dataset = wanted.dataset
    LEFT JOIN weekly ON weekly.dataset = wanted.dataset AND weekly.k = wanted.k AND weekly.week = grid.week
    GROUP BY wanted.dataset, wanted.k
),
prev AS (SELECT dataset, k, sum(prev) AS prev_period FROM weekly GROUP BY dataset, k)
SELECT wanted.dataset, wanted.k, coalesce(cur.n, 0) AS n, coalesce(cur.sources, 0) AS sources,
       cur.first_seen, cur.last_seen, coalesce(prev.prev_period, 0) AS prev_period, med.median_week,
       coalesce(med.weeks, 0) AS weeks
FROM wanted
LEFT JOIN cur ON cur.dataset = wanted.dataset AND cur.k = wanted.k
LEFT JOIN prev ON prev.dataset = wanted.dataset AND prev.k = wanted.k
LEFT JOIN med ON med.dataset = wanted.dataset AND med.k = wanted.k
ORDER BY wanted.dataset, wanted.k
notes: Every count here is Log Entries, not Incidents: one failing node can write thousands of lines about a single problem, so a large count is not many failures. Quote the numbers exactly as given; never round them.

Baselines, per row: prev_period is the count with the same filters in the period of equal length just before the Data Scope, or in the named baseline period (otel_demo: null, because the Data Scope starts at the first Log Entry of otel_demo, so there is no previous period). median_week is the median of the zero-filled weekly counts (Monday-start weeks) with the same filters over the Dataset's whole weeks outside the Data Scope (otel_demo 0). expected is the named baseline period's count scaled to the Data Scope's length when baseline_from and baseline_to are given, else median_week scaled to it, else prev_period scaled to it when fewer than 4 such weeks exist; baseline_basis names the one used (named_period, median_week, previous_period or none). baseline_flag is unusual_high when the count is at least 3 times expected and at least 10 Log Entries above it, unusual_low when it is at most expected / 3 and at least 10 below it, normal otherwise, and no_baseline when neither baseline exists.

otel_demo has fewer than 4 whole weeks outside the Data Scope (0), so median_week is null there and the flag falls back to the previous period, or is no_baseline without one. To see which weeks stand out, call trend over otel_demo, or narrow the time range.
distinct_sources counts BGL nodes, OpenStack instances (instance_ref) and text_bench services (component); OpenStack Log Entries that name no instance are not counted as a source.

SELECT service, count(*) AS spans, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Error') AS error_spans,
       min(ts) AS first_start, max(ts + to_microseconds(duration_ns // 1000)) AS last_end
FROM "huge"."otel_span"
WHERE trace_id = %s
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY first_start, service

WITH RECURSIVE s AS (
    SELECT ts, span_id, parent_span_id, service, operation, kind, duration_ns, status, status_message
    FROM "huge"."otel_span"
    WHERE trace_id = %s
), tree(span_id, depth, path) AS (
    SELECT span_id, 0, [span_id] FROM s WHERE parent_span_id NOT IN (SELECT span_id FROM s)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.span_id, tree.depth + 1, list_append(tree.path, s.span_id)
    FROM s JOIN tree ON s.parent_span_id = tree.span_id
    WHERE tree.depth < 64
), children AS (
    SELECT parent_span_id AS span_id, sum(duration_ns) AS child_ns FROM s GROUP BY parent_span_id
), spans AS (
    SELECT s.*, tree.depth, tree.path, greatest(s.duration_ns - coalesce(children.child_ns, 0), 0) AS self_ns
    FROM s
    LEFT JOIN tree ON tree.span_id = s.span_id
    LEFT JOIN children ON children.span_id = s.span_id
), marked AS (
    SELECT spans.*,
           spans.status = 'Error' AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM spans AS below
               WHERE below.status = 'Error' AND below.span_id <> spans.span_id
                 AND list_contains(below.path, spans.span_id)
           ) AS error_origin,
           row_number() OVER (ORDER BY spans.self_ns DESC, spans.ts) = 1 AS slowest
    FROM spans
)
SELECT ts, service, operation, kind, status, round(duration_ns / 1e6, 3) AS duration_ms,
       round(self_ns / 1e6, 3) AS self_ms, depth, span_id, parent_span_id,
       left(status_message, 240) AS status_message, error_origin,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE error_origin) OVER () AS error_origins, slowest
FROM marked
ORDER BY error_origin DESC, slowest DESC, status = 'Error' DESC, self_ns DESC, ts
LIMIT %s

SELECT "component", "level", count(*) AS n, min("ts_exact") AS first, max("ts_exact") AS last
FROM "huge"."otel_log"
WHERE "trace_id" = %s
GROUP BY component, level
ORDER BY first, component, level

SELECT "ts_exact", "component", "level", "span_id", left("message", 240) AS message
FROM "huge"."otel_log"
WHERE "trace_id" = %s
ORDER BY lower("level") IN ('error', 'fatal', 'critical') DESC, "ts_exact"
LIMIT %s

WITH w AS (
    SELECT service, metric, unit, kind, count(*) AS minutes,
           CASE WHEN kind = 'counter' THEN avg(value) ELSE sum(total) / nullif(sum(n), 0) END AS value
    FROM "huge"."otel_metric_minute"
    WHERE service = ANY(%s::VARCHAR[]) AND minute >= %s AND minute < %s
    GROUP BY service, metric, unit, kind
), judged AS (
    SELECT w.service, w.metric, w.unit, w.kind, w.value, b.p05, b.median, b.p95, w.minutes,
           CASE WHEN w.value IS NULL OR coalesce(b.minutes, 0) < 30 THEN 'no_baseline'
                WHEN w.value > b.p95 + 1e-09 * greatest(abs(b.p95), 1) THEN 'unusual_high'
                WHEN w.value < b.p05 - 1e-09 * greatest(abs(b.p05), 1) THEN 'unusual_low'
                ELSE 'normal' END AS flag,
           b.p95 > b.p05 AS varies,
           CASE WHEN b.p95 > b.p05 THEN abs(w.value - b.median) / (b.p95 - b.p05)
                ELSE abs(w.value - b.median) / greatest(abs(b.median), 1e-9) END AS deviation
    FROM w
    LEFT JOIN "huge"."otel_metric_baseline" AS b
      ON b.service = w.service AND b.metric = w.metric AND b.unit = w.unit AND b.kind = w.kind
)
SELECT service, metric, unit, kind, round(value, 6) AS value, round(p05, 6) AS p05,
       round(median, 6) AS median, round(p95, 6) AS p95, flag, minutes,
       count(*) OVER () AS series_total,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE flag IN ('unusual_high', 'unusual_low')) OVER () AS unusual_total
FROM judged
ORDER BY flag IN ('unusual_high', 'unusual_low') DESC, varies DESC NULLS LAST, deviation DESC NULLS LAST, service, metric
LIMIT %s
